items.title: Amino acids ki activation aur translation ke marhale (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Protein banne se pehle ikaiyan tayyar hoti hain: khaas tRNAs khaas amino acids se jur kar aminoacyl-tRNAs (aa-tRNA) banate hain. Yeh kaam enzyme aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase karta hai; is ki 20 qismein hain, har aik aik amino acid se jurti aur us ke anticodon wale tRNAs pehchanti hai. aa-tRNA amino acid ribosome tak pohanchata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: bara hara enzyme, aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase, jo aik jagah amino acid aur doosri jagah tRNA thaame hai; tRNA ka anticodon wala sira enzyme ke andar. Teer azad aminoacyl-tRNA tak jahan amino acid tRNA ke oopar jura hai, protein banane mein hissa lene ke liye tayyar.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Amino acid, tRNA, Anticodon, Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase, Aminoacyl-tRNA, Ready to participate in protein synthesis.

items: Pehla amino acid le jane wala aa-tRNA chhoti ribosomal subunit se jurta hai, jise initiation factor qaboo karta hai. Prokaryotes mein pehla amino acid N-formyl-methionine aur eukaryotes mein bagair tabdeeli methionine hai.
Aik aur initiation factor mRNA ka 5' sira chhoti subunit se jorta aur aa-tRNA ka anticodon pehle codon, AUG, par rakhta hai.
Bari subunit aa milti hai. Ab initiation complex mein dono subunits, pehla aa-tRNA, mRNA aur factors hain.

blocks.caption: Ribosome ki jaghein
rows: jahan pehla aa-tRNA baithta aur peptide bonds bante hain
jahan se khaali tRNAs nikalte hain

blocks.text: mRNA ke saath yeh jaghein 5' se 3' tak E-P-A tarteeb mein hain, kyunke ribosome 3' sire ki taraf chalta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: chhoti ribosomal subunit, mRNA aur Met wala aminoacyl-tRNA jis ka anticodon UAC start codon AUG se jura hai. Hara teer initiation complex tak: bari subunit aa gayi, Met-tRNA P site mein, khaali E site aur khaali A site ke darmiyan.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.18: Translation ka initiation marhala (kitab ki Figure 19.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Aminoacyl tRNA, Smaller subunit, mRNA, Larger subunit, E site, P site, A site, Initiation complex.

items: Agla aa-tRNA, mutabiq anticodon aur amino acid ke saath, elongation factor ki madad se A site se jurta hai.
Peptidyl transferase P site ke tRNA se amino acid (pehli baar methionine) hata kar A site ke tRNA ke amino acid se peptide bond se jorta hai.
Ribosome mRNA par 5' se 3' ki simt mein teen nucleotides sarakta hai (translocation).
Zanjeer wala tRNA A se P site par aata, A par naya codon khulta, aur khaali tRNA E par ja kar nikal jata hai.
Yeh qadam dohraye jate hain jab tak stop codon A site par na aa jaye.

blocks.alt: mRNA AUG CUG UCU par daire mein saat numbered qadam: (1) Leu-tRNA (anticodon GAC) A site mein aata jab ke Met-tRNA P site mein hai; (2) Met Leu par muntaqil, peptide bond banta hai; (3) ribosome aik codon aage, khaali tRNA E site se nikalta aur Ser-tRNA (anticodon AGA) aata hai; (4) Ser-tRNA A site se jurta; (5) Met-Leu zanjeer Ser par muntaqil; (6) ribosome aage, khaali tRNA bahar; (7) yeh amal har codon ke liye dohraya jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.19: Translation ka elongation marhala (kitab ki Figure 19.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har khaane mein bari aur chhoti subunits, E, P, A sites, anticodons UAC, GAC, AGA wale tRNAs aur barhti zanjeer Met, Leu, Ser.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure ke pehle teen khaanon mein teesra codon AAU chhapa hai aur baad ke khaanon mein UCU. Ser-tRNA ka anticodon AGA sirf UCU se jur sakta hai (UCU = serine; AAU = asparagine), is liye hamare khaake mein har khaane mein UCU likha gaya hai. Har chakkar mein: aa-tRNA A site mein aata, zanjeer us par muntaqil hoti, ribosome aik codon aage barhta aur khaali tRNA E site se nikal jata hai.

Jab stop codon A site par ho to koi aa-tRNA nahi aata kyunke kisi tRNA ka stop codon ke liye anticodon nahi. Release factor naam ka protein stop codon pehchaan kar P site ke tRNA se polypeptide chhorta hai; tRNA chhoot jata aur ribosomal subunits mRNA se alag ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: ribosome jis ki P site mein UGG par tRNA (anticodon ACC) Met-Leu-Ser-Trp zanjeer thaame hai aur A site mein stop codon UAA; release factor qareeb aa raha. Beech: release factor A site mein, polypeptide tRNA se azad. Neeche: polypeptide, bari subunit, chhoti subunit, tRNA aur release factor mRNA se alag.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.20: Translation ka termination marhala (kitab ki Figure 19.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Release factor, Stop codon, Polypeptide, Larger subunit, Smaller subunit, tRNA, mRNA.

blocks.prompt: mRNA AUG UUU GGC UAA hai. Polypeptide mein kitne amino acids hain aur ise kya rokta hai?
blocks.explanation: Teen: methionine, phenylalanine aur glycine. UAA stop codon hai; release factor A site par us se jur kar zanjeer chhorta hai.

items: 20 aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases tRNAs tayyar karte hain.
AUG par (f)Met-tRNA P site mein: initiation.
Elongation: A site mein aamad, peptide bond, 3 nucleotides translocation.
